title: The data economy of public proteomics: thirteen years of PRIDE — analysis code and derived data
description: Analysis code, frozen derived inputs, aggregate evidence and a pre-submission manuscript for 36,249 PRIDE deposits (2013–2025). Code is MIT; author-created data, text and figures are CC BY 4.0, excluding third-party assets. Fresh archive listings and table-header caches retrieved on 11–12 October 2026 accompany the release as a separate asset; they are not the original extraction. Offline checks cover selected analyses, the full adjusted mention-model bootstrap and deposit-clock intervals. See REPRODUCIBILITY.md for coverage and remaining upstream gaps. The BioRender graphical abstract is a preview; publication export and licensing remain unverified.
